scope: Implementation audit of original recurrent KV pair-STDP, using channels as neurons, token as independent write sample, recurrent block as time.
algebra: Verified against independent full ordered-time-pair sums at every prefix, with gradients, heterogeneous decays, spatial rotation and token reduction.
harness: Verified mixed-lane reset, input retention, carry continuity, boundary detach and activation-checkpoint gradient parity.

runtime.limitation: Frozen checkpoint spot check; does not prove equivalence of separate 6000-step training trajectories.

mismatches_with_simplified_derivation.detail: Positive lag uses pre-channel lambda_j; negative lag uses post-channel lambda_i. Exact L_ij(d), not one shared odd L(d). This is a valid generalized STDP rule, not a demonstrated coding error.

Raw key trace is rotated using current theta. If historical rotated K_s is the presynaptic event definition, changing theta across optimizer steps retroactively changes old keys at write time. At fixed theta the two conventions are identical.
mismatches_with_simplified_derivation.possible_correction: If historical rotated activity is intended, store EMA of RoPE_theta_at_event(K) and use that trace directly. Requires an explicit trace-coordinate/checkpoint compatibility change.
mismatches_with_simplified_derivation.causal_status: Not established as cause of collapse; measured local effect is small.

remaining_training_issue: Earlier frozen probes show an approximately two-block cycle of coupled hidden/memory dynamics. This is an observation, not a proof that STDP is invalid or that the cycle causes the accuracy decline.
conclusion: No confirmed sign, axis, trace-order, accumulation, reset or missing-gradient bug explaining collapse. One parameter-update coordinate convention and one scalar-kernel simplification require explicit specification. Cause remains unconfirmed.
